<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-16LE"?>
<resources xmlns:marker="urn:oasis:names:tc:xliff:document:1.2">
  <!-- Every dependency declaration is shadowed and its entire file remains untouched. -->
  <string name="shared_signal">Library <marker:g id="pilot" example="L-0">%1$s</marker:g></string>
  <string name="masked_signal">Library coast</string>
  <string name="product_signal" product="default">Library default beacon</string>
  <string name="product_signal" product="tablet">Library tablet beacon</string>
  <string-array name="product_routes" product="default">
    <item>Library default route</item>
  </string-array>
  <string-array name="product_routes" product="tablet">
    <item>Library tablet route</item>
  </string-array>
  <plurals name="product_lights" product="default">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d library default light</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d library default lights</item>
  </plurals>
  <plurals name="product_lights" product="tablet">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d library tablet light</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d library tablet lights</item>
  </plurals>
  <string-array name="routes">
    <item>Library north</item>
    <item>Library south</item>
  </string-array>
  <plurals name="lights">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d library light</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d library lights</item>
  </plurals>
</resources>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<resources xmlns:marker="urn:oasis:names:tc:xliff:document:1.2">
  <!-- Lower-priority declarations stay byte-for-byte untouched. -->
  <string name="shared_signal">Main <marker:g id="pilot" example="M-1">%1$s</marker:g></string>
  <string name="main_anchor">Main & harbor</string>
  <string name="masked_signal">Lower coast</string>
  <string name="product_signal" product="default">Main default beacon</string>
  <string name="product_signal" product="tablet">Main tablet beacon</string>
  <string-array name="product_routes" product="default">
    <item>Main default route</item>
  </string-array>
  <string-array name="product_routes" product="tablet">
    <item>Main tablet route</item>
  </string-array>
  <plurals name="product_lights" product="default">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d main default light</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d main default lights</item>
  </plurals>
  <plurals name="product_lights" product="tablet">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d main tablet light</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d main tablet lights</item>
  </plurals>
  <string-array name="routes">
    <item>Main north</item>
    <item>Main south</item>
  </string-array>
  <plurals name="lights">
    <item quantity="one">%1$d main light</item>
    <item quantity="other">%1$d main lights</item>
  </plurals>
</resources>
Debug %1$s Protected upper coast Upper tablet beacon Upper tablet route %1$d upper tablet light %1$d upper tablet lights Debug north Debug south %1$d upper light %1$d upper lights Upper only
